_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F22, talk N (the third talk): the sleeping guard drops the cell keys.

text.zh_TW: 衛兵翻了個身，鑰匙圈從腰上滑下來，叮噹一聲掉在你腳邊。「……呼……牢房的鑰匙……不要弄丟……」
text.en: The guard rolls over, and a key ring slides off his belt and clinks at your feet. "...Zzz... the cell keys... don't lose them..."
